title: Gate Valve Frame Replacement
agency: DEPT OF DEFENSE > DEPT OF THE AIR FORCE > AIR FORCE GLOBAL STRIKE COMMAND > FA4608  2 CONS LGC
description: The purpose of this requirement is to replace two (2) rusted vertical frame pieces and one (1) horizontal brace of the original gate valve assembly. Work requires temporarily removing an existing electric motor-driven actuator and retained top headrail, unbolting the frame from its primary lower concrete headwall connection, field-drilling bolt holes to align and secure the retained headrail to the new vertical components, and reattaching the reassembled structure to the concrete headwall strictly in accordance with original gate manufacturer specifications. Following reinstallation of the headrail and motor actuator, the Contractor shall verify that the gate valve is fully operational, traveling freely and without obstruction between the fully open position and achieving a proper seal upon complete closure. The contractor shall provide all logistics, labor, tools, and the lawful disposal of all materials and removed components IAW Attachment 1, Statement of Work, Dated 01 Sep 2026.
